3. Schools should prepare students for professional environments. 
→ Schools should ensure strong ____________. 
 
Exercise 4 — Choose the correct option 
1. Single-sex schools can reduce (peer pressure / healthy competition / 
tailored environment). 
2. Co-education is often preferred due to its emphasis on (social 
maturity / gender stereotypes / social anxiety). 
3. One disadvantage of co-education is possible (real-world preparation 
/ distractions in the learning environment / gender equality). 
Exercise 5 — Create sentences 
Use each phrase in a sentence of your own: 
1. gender interaction 
2. peer pressure 
3. gender-responsive teaching methods 
4. social development 
5. cross-gender communication skills 
 
Exercise 6 — Advanced Paraphrasing Task 
Rewrite each sentence using the highlighted topic vocabulary / 
noun phrases without changing the original meaning. 
1. Studying in a mixed-gender environment helps students learn how to 
communicate effectively with the opposite sex. 
→ 
_______________________________________________________
____ 
2. Boys and girls sometimes struggle to focus because they get 
distracted by each other in class. 
→ 
_______________________________________________________
____ 
3. Teachers in single-sex schools often adapt their lessons to the 
specific learning styles of boys or girls.
